'''Shakra''' was [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who, along with [[Ailyn Vel]], finally corseted [[Bornan Thul]]. Thul escaped however aboard [[Zekk]]'s [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Lightning Rod]]''. When he left, he set his ship to self-destruct. Shakra went aboard the ship, hoping to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] into Bornan's files, but she was disintegrated along with Bornan's ship when it exploded.
